dedupe_keys.name: analysis of the grid capacity for electric vehicles grideva

description: Analysis of the Grid Capacity for Electric Vehicles (GridEVA) is a model listed in Open Energy Platform model and framework factsheets, a public register of energy-system model and framework factsheets under the section "Models", published or maintained by elenia Institute for High Voltage Technology and Power Systems, OFFIS e.V., Leibniz University Hannover, University of Applied Science Emden/Leer. The developed tool GridEVA (Grid Electric Vehicle Analysis) aims to analyze the effects and impacts of an increasing EV penetration rate on the low-voltage grid in districts and identify the maximum possible grid capacity for EV charging using the co-simulation framework mosaik 3.x. Coverage: Germany. Methodical focus: Grid Capacity Analysis, Electric Vehicle Integration, Smart Charging. Time resolution: 15 min. Spatial resolution: districts, households. Software: Python. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is GNU Lesser General Public License v3.0. Caveats: this record was written from the Open Energy Platform factsheet only, so the code, documentation and any publication it links were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the factsheet may lag the project. It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oep-factsheet-catalogue.
